Computer Science is an exciting and constantly evolving field with virtually unlimited growth. With a major in computer science, students are limited only by their imagination. Studying computing will give them a competitive edge, the ability to solve complex problems, and a career that will never be obsolete. A major in Computer Science is a sound investment given the incredible high demand from companies for today’s computer science students.

The undergraduate program in Computer Science is designed so no prior programming experience is necessary, as students will learn basic programming and how to write/understand code throughout their coursework. In this program, they will obtain a deep understanding of computers, the inner workings of software and the application of computer technology to real-world problems.

The Master of Business Administration is specifically designed to provide an intensive business education. Students will acquire critical business knowledge, leadership skills and a strategic mindset to help propel them to the next level of their career with this degree.

The program provides valuable training for professionals pursuing careers in administration and management through skills learned in core business disciplines such as accounting, economics, finance, management, management science, marketing and others. Graduates will work closely with top-notch faculty, and expand their professional network with colleagues who possess a variety of life experiences.
